what: Every .5~2s at a random interval, one of the props in the picture (box, bottle, small animal on the shelf) is picked and shaken ±5~10° in 8 steps (right · 0 · left · 0, twice) on a linear curve — each shake lasts a random .5~1.2s, with a random direction each time. A prop under the pointer shakes in place, and picks happen only while the panel is on screen

options.angle: Sway angle range (deg) ‹min-max›, default 5-10 (Brand underground room 7-12)
options.dur: Range for the length of one shake (seconds) min-max, default .5-1.2 — divided into 8 steps
options.every: Interval range for picking the next prop (seconds) ‹min-max›, default .5-2
options.hover: If false, it won’t wiggle even on hover

from.where: index.html .house wooden house cross-section — original ueSetting and shitaSetting: pick one prop img every r(.5,2)s with rotation ±r(5,10) (underground ±r(7,12)), 8 steps linear, step r(.5,1.2)/8s, also on mouseenter
